description: Per-package rulings on the custom track finish rank (#133 PR 4c, A2-22). A custom track whose LEV has super turbo pads needs USF to finish unless a ruling here says otherwise (ruling 2026-10-18: "they require USF UNLESS I say otherwise"). Keyed by registry content id (the package's content_id). A row without revision covers every revision of that track; a row with revision also names the package's LEV pin (lev_sha256) and covers only that exact package, and it wins over a row without revision. finish_rank is the Progressive Boost rank crossing the finish line needs: 2 USF, 1 the first boost, 0 the generic terms only. Each entry cites its ruling. Only ruled or certified rows go here; a player finishing a track is not certification. Project-owned: this is never a package descriptor field. A package no row matches keeps the measured default.
